name: Webcam Mic
description:
Switch an Insta360 Link webcam's AI noise cancelling on and off from Quick Settings.

A webcam that removes background noise also removes an assistant talking out of your speakers, and much of anybody talking over it — right in a meeting, wrong when you want to interrupt something. Insta360 ships no Linux control app and ALSA exposes nothing but capture volume, so this drives link-ctl, which speaks to the camera over USB.
